content:
On Tuesday morning, October 20, Laredo ISD put every campus in the district on "secure mode" after police advised the precaution following a threat directed at an unnamed school. According to KGNS, parents were told at 8:10 a.m. to keep students and staff inside buildings while officers investigated.

Laredo police later told KGNS the investigation was contained and there was no longer a threat, and the district lifted the secure status across its campuses. The Laredo Morning Times also reported the lockdown lift Tuesday morning.

This was not a lockdown of one building — it was a district-wide posture affecting every LISD school. The threat was directed at a single unnamed campus, but the district and police treated it as serious enough to restrict movement across the entire system until the all-clear.

What we still don't know

As of the reporting published so far, the public does not know which campus received the threat, what form the threat took, who reported it, or how parents were first notified. Those are the basic facts a district owes families after a morning like this one — and they are the questions Webb Watch will be watching for the district to answer:

  • Which campus was the target, and what kind of threat was reported?
  • When was the threat first received, and who called it in?
  • How did the district communicate with parents, and at what point in the morning?
  • Will the district say publicly what steps it is taking so that one morning's threat does not become the next one?

The good news is that the system worked the way it is supposed to: police investigated, the threat was contained, and students and staff stayed inside until officers said the danger had passed. But a district-wide secure mode is not a drill, and families deserve the details of what triggered it.

Sources: KGNS, "LISD places all schools on 'secure mode' amid unspecified threat," Oct. 20, 2026; Laredo Morning Times, "Laredo ISD schools lift secure status after reported threat," Oct. 20, 2026.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956

title: Every LISD Campus Went on Secure Mode Tuesday Morning. The Threat Is Contained, but the Details Aren't Public.
